discovery_candidates.name: Joplin
discovery_candidates.description: Note taking application with markdown editor and encryption support for mobile and desktop platforms. Runs client-side and syncs through a self hosted Nextcloud instance or similar (alternative to Evernote).

discovery_candidates.name: Nextcloud
discovery_candidates.description: Access and share your files, calendars, contacts, mail and [more](https://apps.nextcloud.com/) from any device, on your terms.

discovery_candidates.name: transfer.sh
discovery_candidates.description: Easy file sharing from the command line.

discovery_candidates.name: Seafile
discovery_candidates.description: File hosting and sharing solution primary for teams and organizations.

discovery_candidates.name: TagSpaces
discovery_candidates.description: TagSpaces is an offline, cross-platform file manager and organiser that also can function as a note taking app. The WebDAV version of the application can be installed on top of a WebDAV servers such as Nextcloud or ownCloud.

discovery_candidates.name: slskd
discovery_candidates.description: A modern client-server application for the Soulseek file sharing network.

discovery_candidates.name: Nextcloud Memories
discovery_candidates.description: Fast, modern and advanced photo management suite. Runs as a Nextcloud app.

discovery_candidates.name: Zipline
discovery_candidates.description: A lightweight, fast and reliable file sharing server that is commonly used with ShareX, offering a react-based Web UI and fast API.

discovery_candidates.name: NextCloudPi
discovery_candidates.description: Nextcloud preinstalled and preconfigured, with a text and web management interface and all the tools needed to self host private data. With installation images for Raspberry Pi, Odroid, Rock64, Docker, and a curl installer for Armbian/Debian.

discovery_candidates.name: ByteStash
discovery_candidates.description: Pastebin and file storage service with a simple web interface. Supports syntax highlighting, optional user authentication and public sharing.

discovery_candidates.name: Pydio
discovery_candidates.description: Turn any web server into a powerful file management system and an alternative to mainstream cloud storage providers.

discovery_candidates.name: PsiTransfer
discovery_candidates.description: Simple file sharing solution with robust up-/download-resume and password protection.

discovery_candidates.name: Sync-in
discovery_candidates.description: File storage, syncing, sharing, and collaboration with real-time editing, permission management, and desktop/CLI clients.

discovery_candidates.name: Hoodik
discovery_candidates.description: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage server. Files are encrypted and decrypted in the browser, so the server only ever holds ciphertext. Runs on SQLite or PostgreSQL, stores chunks on local disk or any S3-compatible service.
